items.title: Keep Chat clear during its first layout
items.detail: Tuner reserves space for its message field before Chat's first layout measurement, keeping the conversation controls clear.

items.title: See your saved agents at launch
items.detail: Tuner shows the saved agent list as soon as it opens, then reconciles it with the current roster.

items.title: Send sits beside the message field
items.detail: Send is a separate control beside the field and stays aligned with the last line as the field grows.

items.title: See when an agent is replying
items.detail: After you send a prompt, its row moves to Replies with a spinner until a new assistant message arrives. If sending fails, the row stays where it was.

items.title: Send matches the message field
items.detail: The one-line Send control matches the 44-point field height, while multiline drafts keep it aligned with the last line.

items.title: Release notes match the build
items.detail: Each numbered archive requires notes for that exact build. Tuner's What's Changed and TestFlight use the same authored notes.
